tagline: Leading global supplier of advanced lithography systems for semiconductor manufacturing
hero_kpi_rationale: ASML invests heavily in R&D to maintain its technological leadership in the semiconductor industry and develop tomorrow's energy-efficient solutions

kpis.name: R&D Investments as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of net revenue
kpis.description: ASML invests heavily in R&D to develop new technologies and energy-efficient solutions, targeting a range of 10-15% of revenue
kpis.signal: Significant investment in R&D to maintain technological leadership

kpis.name: Total GHG Emissions
kpis.description: Total GHG emissions are decreasing due to energy efficiency initiatives and increased use of renewable energy
kpis.signal: Reduction in GHG emissions compared to 2024

kpis.name: Total Energy Consumption
kpis.explanation: Total energy consumption (fossil and renewable sources)
kpis.description: ASML consumed 639,585 MWh in 2025, of which 82.5% came from renewable sources
kpis.signal: Increase in energy consumption due to operational growth, offset by higher renewable energy usage

kpis.name: Share of Renewable Energy
kpis.explanation: Percentage of renewable energy in total energy consumption
kpis.description: ASML is increasing its share of renewable energy through Guarantees of Origin and Renewable Energy Certificates
kpis.signal: Growing share of renewable energy in ASML's energy mix

kpis.name: Carbon Credits Retired
kpis.explanation: Carbon credits retired to offset GHG emissions
kpis.description: ASML retired 104 ktCO2e of carbon credits in 2025, 100% from removal projects and recognized standards
kpis.signal: Use of high-quality carbon credits for emissions offsetting

kpis.name: Energy Intensity per Revenue
kpis.explanation: Energy intensity per million euros of net revenue
kpis.description: ASML reduced its energy intensity to 19.6 MWh per million euros of revenue, demonstrating improved energy efficiency
kpis.signal: Declining energy intensity due to efficiency improvements

kpis.name: Total GHG Emissions
kpis.description: ASML is working to reduce its GHG emissions through energy efficiency initiatives and the adoption of renewable energy
kpis.signal: Reduction in GHG emissions compared to 2024

kpis.name: Share of Renewable Energy
kpis.explanation: Percentage of renewable energy in total energy consumption
kpis.description: ASML is increasing its share of renewable energy through growing Renewable Energy Certificates and Guarantees of Origin
kpis.signal: Growing share of renewable energy in the energy mix

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: ASML integrates artificial intelligence and machine learning into the optimization of its production processes and lithographic solution routing
evidence: Use of AI to optimize production processes and reduce energy consumption
Development of efficient algorithms for GPUs and next-generation platforms
Focus on minimizing computational footprint per device layer
